content.hebrew: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד מַלְאֲכֵי שְׁבִיבוֹ,
content.transliteration: El na‘arats besod mal’akhē shevivo,
content.english: God, declared formidable by the council of His fiery angels,

content.hebrew: הַשָּׂם בְּקִרְבּוֹ אֶת־רֽוּחַ קָדְשׁוֹ, כִּי אֲהֵבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Hassam beḳirbo et ru’aḥ ḳodsho, ki ahevo.
content.english: Who placed His holy spirit inside [Moses], for He loved him.

content.hebrew: רוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן, וּתְרוּעַת מֶֽלֶךְ בּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ro‘ē ne’eman, utru‘at melekh bo.
content.english: [He was] a faithful shepherd, and the king’s will was with him.

content.hebrew: נֹֽפֶת תִּטֹּֽפְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתָיו, וְצוּף דְּבַשׁ נִיבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Nofet tittofena siftotav, vetsuf devash nivo.
content.english: His lips dripped with honey, and flowing nectar was his speech.

content.hebrew: הַמּוֹרֶה לְעַם אֵל מַעְגַּל יֽוֹשֶׁר, לְהֵיטִיבוֹ,
content.transliteration: Hammorē la‘am El ma‘gal yosher, lehetivo,
content.english: He taught God’s people the upright path to bring them goodness,

content.hebrew: צַו לָצָו, עַל בָּמֳתֵי שֵֽׂכֶל לְהַרְכִּיבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Tsav latsav, ‘al bamotē sekhel leharkivo.
content.english: Commandment by commandment, to let them summit intellectual peaks.

content.hebrew: עֵֽקֶב יִשְׁמַע מִשְׁפְּטֵי אֵל עַם קְרוֹבוֹ,
content.transliteration: ‘eḳev yishma‘ mishpetē El ‘am ḳerovo,
content.english: In consequence of [the fact that] God’s close people will listen to His laws,

content.hebrew: יִשְׁמֹר לוֹ יוי בְּרִית וָחֶֽסֶד – נַהֲרֵי טוּבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yishmor lo Adonai berit vaḥesed – naharē tuvo.
content.english: Adonai will keep for them the covenant and the kindness—the rivers of His goodness.

content.hebrew: רָנֵּי פַלֵּט יְסוֹבְבֶֽנּוּ, יָסִיר עָצְבּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ronnē fallet yesov’vennu, yasir ‘otsbo,
content.english: He will surround them with joyous songs of deliverance, and remove their sadness.

content.hebrew: בְּרָכוֹת עֲצוּמוֹת רָשַׁם בְּמִכְתָּבוֹ:
content.transliteration: Berakhot ‘atsumot rasham bemikhtavo:
content.english: He has recorded mighty blessings in His writing:

content.hebrew: יְבָרֵךְ פְּרִי בִטְנוֹ, יִרְכַּב עַל בָּמֳתֵי אוֹיְבוֹ;
content.transliteration: Yevarekh peri vitno, yirkav ‘al bamotē ‘oyevo;
content.english: He will bless the fruit of their womb, who will ride over their enemy’s back;

content.hebrew: יָסִיר מִמֶּֽנּוּ כָּל־חֽוֹלִי, עֲדֵי יִתְּנֵם לְאוֹרְבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Yasir mimmennu kol ḥoli, ‘adē yittenem le’orevo.
content.english: He will remove all sickness from them, such that He gives it to their ambushers.

content.hebrew: יִמְשׁוֹל עַמִּים בְּקַשְׁתּוֹ וּבְחַרְבּוֹ;
content.transliteration: Yimshol ‘ammim beḳashto uvḥarbo;
content.english: [Israel] will rule over nations, with their bow and their sword;

content.hebrew: יוּכַל לְהוֹרִישָׁם, יְמַלֵּא מִשְׁאַל לְבָבוֹ,
content.transliteration: Yuḥal lehorisham, yemallē mish’al levavo,
content.english: They will be able to dispossess them, and fulfill their hearts’ desire,

content.hebrew: כִּי יוי יִהְיֶה מָגִנּוֹ וּמִשְׂגַּבּוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ki Adonai yihyē maḡinno umisgabbo.
content.english: For Adonai will be their shield and their stronghold.

content.hebrew: פְּסִִילֵי אֱלִיל יִשְׂרוֹף, לֹא יַחְמוֹד כַּסְפּוֹ וּזְהָבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Pesilē elil yisrof, lo yaḥmod kaspo uzhavo.
content.english: They should burn the idols of deities, and not desire their silver or gold.

content.hebrew: מַהֲלַל אֵל יִהְיֶה בְּפִיו, בְּקוּמוֹ וּבְמִשְׁכָּבוֹ,
content.transliteration: Mahalal el yihyē befiv, beḳumo uvmishkavo,
content.english: Praise of God should be in their mouth, when they arise and when they lie down,

content.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הֶאֱכִילוֹ מָן, וְעִנָּֽהוּ וְהִרְעִיבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Asher he’ekhilo man, ve‘innahu vehir‘ivo.
content.english: For He has fed them manna, [after] having afflicted and starved them.

content.hebrew: כֹּֽחַ אִזְּרוֹ, הוֹד עִטְּרוֹ, כִּי אִשְּׁרוֹ כְּשַׂרְפֵי לְהָבוֹ;
content.transliteration: Ko’aḥ izzero, hod ittero, ki ish’shero kesarfē lehavo;
content.english: He has girded them with strength, and crowned them with splendor, for He has given them fortune like his flaming seraphim;

content.hebrew: לָכֵן יַעֲרִיץ וְיַקְדִּישׁ בְּכָל־מַחֲשָׁבוֹ,
content.transliteration: Lakhen ya‘arits veyaḳdish bekhol maḥashavo,
content.english: Therefore, [Israel] should declare [God’s] formidability and sanctity, full-mindedly,

content.hebrew: קהל: בְּשִׁיר נִמְרָץ לְאֵל נַעֲרָץ וְנוֹרָא עַל כָּל־סְבִיבוֹ.
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Beshir nimrats le’El na‘arats venora ‘al kol sevivo.
content.english: Cong. With forceful song to the God declared formidable, who is awesome over all His surroundings.

content.hebrew: חזן: יו֤י אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־כָמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמ֥וּנָֽתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃ (תהלים פט:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Adonai elohē tseva’ot mi khamokha ḥasin Yah ve’emunatekha sevivotekha:
content.english: Cantor:Adonai, God of Hosts, who is like You, O mighty one, Yah? And Your faithfulness is upon Your surroundings. (Ps. 89:9)

content.hebrew: אֵֽין־קָד֥וֹשׁ כַּיו֖י כִּ֣י אֵ֣ין בִּלְתֶּ֑ךָ וְאֵ֥ין צ֖וּר כֵּאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ (שמואל א ב:ב)
content.transliteration: En ḳadosh ka’Adonai ki en biltekha, ve’en tsur kelohenu:
content.english: There is none holy like Adonai, for there is none but You; and there is no rock like our God. (1 Sam. 2:2)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
